sources.searcher_note: Profile interview of NHT's CEO Raul Rodriguez; names the entity but says nothing about any exclusion or ban. Context only, not the finding.

notes: No source found that ties either company, or anyone at them, to an OIG exclusion. Profile pages (theorg.com, LinkedIn, Voyage MIA) show Raul Rodriguez as CEO of National Health Transport and a Kevin Smith as owner of ASAP EMS, which only confirms who signs; none mention a ban, so the namesake question stays open. The OIG hit on ASAP's city (Laurel, MS, 2015) was South Central Regional Medical Center, not ASAP EMS. Only pattern coverage (OIG 2016) found.
